definitions.gloss: in an instant; instantaneously; in a flash
definitions.explanation: Happening in an extremely short amount of time, almost immediately. Emphasizes the speed at which something occurs.

examples.japanese: {瞬時|しゅんじ}に⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧。
⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{瞬時|しゅんじ}に⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: The fire spread to the entire building in an instant.

examples.japanese: AI⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{瞬時|しゅんじ}に⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧になった。
examples.english: We have entered an era where AI processes vast amounts of data instantaneously.

notes: Composed of {瞬|しゅん} (blink/moment) + ⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧ (time) + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (adverbial particle). The base noun ⟦{瞬時|しゅんじ}→瞬時：13662_shunji⟧ can also be used in other constructions: ⟦{瞬時|しゅんじ}→瞬時：13662_shunji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧ (split-second judgment). Common collocations: {瞬時|しゅんじ}に⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧ (judge instantly), {瞬時|しゅんじ}に⟦{反応|はんのう}する→反応する：20204_hannousuru⟧ (react instantly), {瞬時|しゅんじ}に⟦{理解|りかい}する→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧ (understand instantly). Similar expressions: ⟦{一瞬|いっしゅん}→一瞬：01805_isshun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (in a moment), ⟦たちまち→たちまち：07371_tachimachi⟧ (immediately).
